Terms & Conditions

Last updated: October 2026

1. General

These terms apply to every order placed through the LumiWear website. By placing an order you agree to these terms.

2. Prices

All prices are in Polish złoty (PLN) and include VAT. Shipping costs are shown in your cart before you order.

3. Ordering and payment

After you place an order, we email you an order confirmation with a secure payment link. The agreement is final once payment is received. Orders that aren’t paid within 7 days are cancelled automatically.

4. Delivery

We aim to ship within 1–2 working days after payment. Delivery times are estimates. If delivery takes longer than 30 days, you may cancel your order for a full refund.

5. Right of withdrawal

You may withdraw from your purchase within 30 days of delivery without giving a reason, as described on our Shipping & Returns page.

6. Complaints

If a product is faulty, let us know through the contact page. We respond within 14 days, as required by law. You can also use the EU Online Dispute Resolution platform at ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr.

7. Applicable law

These terms are governed by Polish law, without affecting the consumer protection rules of your country of residence.
